notes: NPCI UPI OC 228 (08-10-2025) and the UPI Consolidated Circular v1.0 para 16.1 extend Reserve Pay to all UPI-permitted sources of funds, naming savings, current and overdraft accounts, RuPay credit cards and pre-sanctioned credit lines; the extant pricing of RuPay credit cards and credit lines on UPI applies to executed debits. funding stays debit for this descriptor: a block on a RuPay credit card or a credit line is a credit-funded leg (funding credit, in.upi.rupay_cc or in.upi.credit_line), which the PSP attestation states and which needs credit_funding_allowed. Acquirer eligibility: OC 228 enables Reserve Pay to begin with only for 'online verified merchants with low ticket and high frequency transactions'. One mobile number may hold only one block at a time for a particular merchant (OC 228 Issuer Banks para 4; Consolidated Circular para 16.4); no NPCI text caps blocks per user across merchants. A block is not a guarantee of payment. A timeout on a debit is a decline, reversed in real time and not settled; for timeouts only, acquiring entities may retry at most 3 times in 24 hours (OC 228 Acquiring entities para 3). The payer is notified of block creation, modification, debit, revoke and expiry (OC 228 Issuer Banks para 2; Consolidated Circular para 16.11); no NPCI text found states whether a pre-debit notice applies (Q-03). The payee PSP and the UPI app must give the user a facility to revoke the block (Consolidated Circular para 16.10); the merchant gives the facility to modify its amount or validity (para 16.9). No public NPCI list of the issuers that support Reserve Pay was found as of 17-10-2026 (an absence finding; Q-04). NPCI product page: block set up with UPI PIN; unused money is released on expiry or cancellation.
